formula.ascii: Distance component for valid origin-anchored local IJK coordinates u and v: Delta = u - v; d = max(Delta.x, Delta.y, Delta.z) - min(Delta.x, Delta.y, Delta.z). This is the maximum component after IJK normalization. Invalid/masked local conversions write 0xffffffff. Optional paths use sequential integer cube rounding and unique-neighbor lookup, not this closed-form distance alone; failed path lookup writes counts=0 while retaining distance. Successful stored prefixes report distance+1 even when capacity truncates them.
